abort.reauth_account_mismatch: The credentials belong to a different E.ON Next account. Re-authenticate with the original account.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to E.ON Next API
error.invalid_auth: Refresh token rejected - get a fresh one and try again

reauth_confirm.description: The saved login for {email} is no longer valid. Log in at eonnext.com in a browser, open DevTools → Console and run: Object.keys(localStorage).filter(k=>k.startsWith('@@auth0spajs@@')).map(k=>JSON.parse(localStorage[k]).body?.refresh_token).find(Boolean) - paste the value without quotes, then close the tab WITHOUT logging out (logging out revokes the token).
reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Eon Next

user.description: E.ON Next now signs in through Auth0, so a password can't be used. Log in at eonnext.com in a browser, open DevTools → Console and run: Object.keys(localStorage).filter(k=>k.startsWith('@@auth0spajs@@')).map(k=>JSON.parse(localStorage[k]).body?.refresh_token).find(Boolean) - paste the value without quotes, then close the tab WITHOUT logging out (logging out revokes the token).
user.title: Login
